info.title: Equipment Booking API
info.description: REST API of the equipment reservation and inventory management system. All requests and responses use JSON; errors follow RFC 9457 problem details with a stable "code" field.

get.summary: Lists assessments with the result of every policy check, the purpose check and the outcome.
Lists the routed requests of the manager's department with the reasons for routing, oldest first.

post.summary: Signs in with e-mail and password.
post.description: Returns an access token for the Authorization header and sets the refresh token as an HttpOnly cookie.

post.summary: Issues a new access token using the refresh token cookie and rotates the cookie.

delete.summary: Signs out: revokes the refresh token and deletes the cookie.

post.summary: Requests an item for a date range; the request blocks the item and runs the approval route.
post.description: An overlapping request is rejected with 409 and the conflicting periods in "conflictingPeriods".

get.summary: Returns a booking to its requester, the manager of the requester's department or an administrator.

patch.summary: Changes the dates of a requested or approved booking; the request is checked and routed again.

post.summary: Cancels a requested or approved booking and frees its dates.
Approves or declines a routed request of the manager's department; a decline needs a comment.

get.summary: Returns the return history of the requester to the department manager.

post.summary: Records the issue of an approved booking from its start date.

put.summary: Records the return of an issued or overdue loan with the condition of the item.

get.summary: Lists all categories.

post.summary: Creates a category; the maximum loan duration and usage guidelines are required.

get.summary: Searches the catalogue by keyword and filters it by category, location, features and availability.

parameters.name: AvailableFrom
parameters.description: Together with AvailableTo: only items free for the whole inclusive range.

parameters.name: Sort
parameters.description: name, inventoryNumber or value; prefix with "-" for descending order.

post.summary: Adds an item to the catalogue with the status Available.

get.summary: Returns the card of an item.
Returns the periods in which the item is booked or out of service, without names of employees.
Returns the loans, condition changes and maintenance of an item in date order.

post.summary: Retires an item that has no current or future bookings; its history is kept.

get.summary: Lists loans by state: "ready" (approved, start date reached), "active" or "overdue".
Lists the maintenance records of an item, newest first.

post.summary: Records maintenance. An out of service period with bookings returns 409 with "affectedBookings" until confirmed.

get.summary: Returns the profile of the signed in user.

put.summary: Records that the user has seen the privacy notice (acknowledgement, not consent).

get.summary: Lists the bookings of the signed in employee with status and who decided.
Lists the notifications of the signed in user, newest first.
Returns the number of unread notifications.
Lists the locations.
Lists the departments.
Lists the searchable item features.
Lists the item conditions from best to worst.
Lists the maintenance types.
Returns the low value threshold, the automatic approval switch, the retention period and the return time.

put.summary: Updates the settings; they apply to the next processed request.

get.summary: Lists users filtered by name or e-mail, role and department.

post.summary: Creates a user with an initial password.

put.summary: Updates name, role, department and active state; a role change ends the user's sessions.
Sets a new password and ends the user's sessions.

AssessmentCheckInfo.description: Result of one policy check with the compared values, for example the item value and the threshold.

BookedPeriod.description:
Period in which the item is not free; never contains the names of other employees (US-04).
An overdue loan and a maintenance period without a known end have no end date: the item stays
blocked until it is returned or the maintenance ends.

CancellationInfo.description: Why a cancelled booking was cancelled, for example by the requester or because no decision was made in time.

CurrentUserResponse.description: Profile of the signed in user.

DecisionInfo.description: Who took the current decision: a manager (with name) or the AI assistant.

EquipmentHistoryEvent.description: Event in the history of an item (US-32).

PagedResultOfApprovalQueueItem.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfAssessmentLogEntry.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfBookingSummary.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfEquipmentListItem.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfLoanListItem.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfNotificationResponse.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

PagedResultOfUserResponse.description: One page of a list with the total number of matching items.

RequesterHistoryResponse.description: Return history of a requester shown to the manager (US-12); never sent to the language model.

SessionResponse.description: Access token for the Authorization header and the profile of the signed in user.
